cells.Values and default: Path of a JSON file. The file is an array of token ids, or an object that maps a prompt key (comma-separated token ids) or `default` to tokens to emit. Unset: an error is logged, and every generation fails with `proxy: golden map unavailable`. Empty: the same failure, with the cause `cannot open TRON_GOLDEN_TOKENS file`.
cells.Effect: Names the file from which `rinzler_proxy` takes the tokens that it emits in place of running a model. The variable and the file are read again for every generation. A changed file takes effect at the next request. An unreadable, non-JSON or wrongly shaped file fails every generation the same way. The process keeps running. A file with `rendered_at` needs `RZ_SYSTEM_START_DATE` with the same text. Each generation logs `proxy: prompt key <key> -> <N> golden tokens`. `README.proxy.md` describes the format.

cells.Values and default: Integer, parsed with `atoi`. A working value is 1 or more. Unit: tokens that one forward pass computes. Text that is not a number counts as `0`. Unset: 100000000 tokens (100 million). Empty: counts as `0`, and the process aborts in a forward pass.
cells.Effect: Limits the number of tokens that one forward pass computes. A forward pass is one run of the model over a group of tokens. At the limit the scheduler stops adding tokens to the pass, and a later pass computes the remaining tokens. With `0` or a negative number, no token enters a pass. The assertion `Scheduler stuck: no work scheduled but not finished` then aborts the process. When `max_minibatches` (`rinzler --max-batches`, `runtron --max-minibatches`) is above 0, the limit is at most `max_minibatches` times the maximum minibatch size.

cells.Effect: Sets the time zone of the local date and time that rinzler writes into prompts. This affects `conversation_start_date` in the system message of `gpt-oss` models, the output of `strftime_now` in chat templates, and the `rendered_at` field of a `save_tokens` capture. `RZ_SYSTEM_START_DATE` pins the date.
